svg.title: DocAI — full system flowchart from user login to streamed answer
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom flowchart showing five phases: authentication, document upload, document processing pipeline, hybrid retrieval engine, and LangGraph agent with streaming response.

g.text: bcrypt verifies password → creates JWT token
PDF · DOCX · PPTX · XLSX · CSV · image
validates type + size → saves to disk → creates DB record
User types a question in chat
merge by rank position, not raw score
classifies intent: qa / compare / summarize / extract
picks retrieval strategy for that intent
LLM writes answer from chunks only, cites [Page X]
tokens stream word by word to browser
